candidate_evidence.quote: [DEVICE] NaviFUS System (other names: Focused ultrasound, Low-Intensity Focused Ultrasound)

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Histologically proven Grade IV glioma patients that is recurrent following standard radiation therapy (RT) and temozolomide

coder_notes: Device trial: low-intensity focused ultrasound (NaviFUS) as radiosensitiser with re-irradiation (SRS or conventional RT) in recurrent grade III-IV glioma; Phase NA. No registered drug intervention. SonoVue (microbubbles), FET and FDG PET tracers and MRI/CT contrast agents appear only in an allergy exclusion criterion; PET uptake is an 'other' outcome. Not listed as agents because they are not registered interventions and the record does not state that every patient receives them. cns5 historical: 'Grade IV glioma' without IDH requirement and 'Glioblastoma Multiforme' in official title.
